task_completion.description: Load both the CT series from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/pmr_ct/ and the MRI series from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/pmr_mri/ into the Weasis viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis interface showing thumbnails or image stacks for both CT and MRI modalities in the explorer or main view.

task_completion.description: Configure Weasis to display the CT and MRI series simultaneously in a side-by-side or split-screen layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing two distinct image viewports within the Weasis application, one containing CT and the other containing MRI.

task_completion.description: Apply bone windowing to the CT image and soft tissue windowing to the MRI image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CT image should show high contrast for bone (white) with dark soft tissue; the MRI should show clear differentiation of soft tissue structures (gray scales).

task_completion.description: Perform line measurements across a bony structure on the CT and a corresponding region on the MRI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Measurement lines (calipers) with numerical values in mm visible on both the CT and MRI viewports.
A file manager window or terminal output showing the existence of comparison_view.png in the specified directory, or the 'Export' dialog being used.

task_completion.description: Create a clinical report at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/comparison_report.txt containing measurements and clinical correlation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing the report content with 'mm' measurements and text describing the correlation between CT and MRI findings.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to perform measurements and windowing rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis tools (ruler icon, windowing presets) and the Weasis application window being active.

integrity.description: The measurements in the report match the visual measurements shown in the Weasis GUI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numerical values (mm) visible on the screen in Weasis match the text written in comparison_report.txt.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific DICOM files provided in the pmr_ct and pmr_mri directories.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file paths in the Weasis import dialog or the metadata displayed in the DICOM viewer match the assigned directories.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use Weasis to correlate CT (bone window) and MRI (soft tissue window). The CT data is located in /home/ga/DICOM/studies/pmr_ct/ and MRI in /home/ga/DICOM/studies/pmr_mri/. The final outputs must be a PNG image at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/comparison_view.png and a text report at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/comparison_report.txt. The report must include specific mm measurements and a clinical correlation statement consistent with a PM&R physician's perspective on joint pain.
